# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}

Unblock a user from the organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-090`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Cannot unblock user (not blocked, target is org, or insufficient permissions)
- **404** — User not found
- **422** — Validation error
